entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: %s() is not a supported scalar argument
entries.rationale: The parser's type checker admits only scalar() / time() / pi() as scalar-returning calls; pi() folds via TryFoldScalar before this dispatch, and the other two are handled — the arm guards future upstream scalar functions.

entries.head: promql
entries.rationale: The scalar-typed expression space is closed by the parser's type checker: literal trees fold, Paren/Unary/Binary recurse, and the three scalar-returning calls are handled — no parseable scalar argument reaches the default arm.
